title: Mihakk reproduce result
description: Outcome of `mihakk reproduce <case-id>`. Reproduction is never assumed to succeed: the target may respond differently, and timing indicators in particular vary between runs.

fidelity.description: exact = the corpus, config and engine version all still match the recipe, so the regenerated request is byte-identical to the original. drifted = at least one input changed, so this is a close approximation and the differences are listed in drift. The command MUST NOT claim an exact replay when fidelity is drifted.

drift.description: Present when fidelity is drifted. Each entry names one input that changed since the case was recorded.

effect.description: Plain-language note on what this means for the comparison.

authorization_revalidated.description: Reproduction re-runs the full authorisation, scope and limit checks. It is never exempt from them.

indicator_reappeared.description: Whether the original indicator was observed again. null when the request could not be sent at all.

comparison_note.description: Human-readable comparison. A non-reappearing indicator is not evidence that the original observation was wrong, and a reappearing one is not confirmation of a vulnerability.
